I told Dana in a thread on their #north-team message that the 2026 Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal is settled at **261 seats**.

- **Source:** Ilse's post in #north-team on Oct 14. Nothing posted since then changes that number. The share has no Quarrendon account files, and the incident channel Dana is in (#inc-qfl-sev1) has no messages in that period, so Ilse's post is the only source.
